verification.precondition: The exact frozen pre-R12 ancestry and complete seven-product Round-1 instrument unit are available.
verification.stimulus: Resolve the unit's exact twenty-two dependency edges and traverse the complete dependency graph in reverse from each future S20 ancestor unit.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The QuestionFrameSet, Round-frame, and Survey-frame units each reach all seven instrument heads; every new edge is owned by the instrument unit; and RoundInstrument invalidation identifies and clears the sole handoff.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal graph reachability, edge confinement, forbidden-edge absence, and pure handoff-partition assertions.
verification.forbiddenMutation: No revision is executed or claimed, no production state is mutated, and no extra edge or traversal relation is admitted.

behavior: R12 dependency graph proves forward S20 reverse reachability without claiming revision execution
